newsitem.title: ESTONIA: EESTI KINDLUSTUS COLLECTS 19.5 MLN IN PREMIUMS.
newsitem.headline: EESTI KINDLUSTUS COLLECTS 19.5 MLN IN PREMIUMS.

text.p: Eesti Kindlustus, the insurance subsidiary of Estonia's Hoiupank, said on Thursday that it had collected 19.5 million kroons in premiums in May.
Premium collection rose by 1.3 times compared to May last year, it added in a statement.
Non-life insurance accounted for 78.5 percent of the total and life insurance premiums reached 4.1 million kroons.
Life insurance premiums have risen by 42 percent compared to May 1996.
Payments in life insurance were 1.2 million kroons and in non-life insurance 5.6 million kroons in May.
Current year premium collections were at 90.1 million kroons at the end of May, compared to 73.4 million kroons during the same period last year.
